name: Apollo 17
intro: Gene Cernan here. This is the last Apollo to the Moon, so let's make it count!
We bring the first real geologist to the Moon: Jack Schmitt.
Our target: the Taurus-Littrow valley, walls taller than the Grand Canyon.
Finalists were Gassendi and Alphonsus too. Low Sun at landing, please!
briefing: Narrow valley, big mountains, no room for mistakes.
fact: Jack Schmitt found orange soil at Taurus-Littrow: tiny glass beads from an old volcanic fountain.
